source.title: Collective model description of transitional odd-A nuclei (II). Comparison with unique parity states of nuclei in the A=135 and A=190 mass regions

claims.claim: Author explicitly says it would be naive to take rigid shape literally and begins only a qualitative softness discussion. Fig10 is a schematic PES classification, not a new isotope-specific calculation.
claims.dependency_and_boundary: dependent on specified PartI model; not new experiment

claims.claim: Table6 compares complete Wilets–Jean gamma-independent limit, one rigid triaxial rotor point, and cited 190Os/124Xe ratios. Both complete-soft and rigid endpoints are not attained by cited data; author infers finite spread, not measured gamma width.
claims.dependency_and_boundary: experiments cited Refs13/42, not independently read here; two ratios share level inputs

claims.claim: Main text says microscopic PES Refs33–35 lack pronounced triaxial minima, while same-page footnote preserves Ref36 recent triaxial-minimum exceptions near N76 and 56<=Z<=66.
claims.locator: PDF21/printed161 body and footnote; PDF25 Ref36
claims.dependency_and_boundary: cited theory, not independently verified originals

claims.claim: Table7 distinguishes calculated state-dependent beta_rms/gamma_rms from standard fit beta/gamma. Dynamic right column is 196Pt, standard column is printed 196Hg; not silently merged or corrected.
claims.dependency_and_boundary: rms from Ref33; fit parameters from this model; different quantities and partly different nuclei

claims.claim: Au h11/2 and Tl h9/2 fits near gamma37 within about2deg and agreement with Hg cores motivate author interpretation of less-soft Hg and possible triaxial minima; evidence explicitly weaker for Os/Pt/A135.
claims.dependency_and_boundary: fits/calibration and author interpretation, not direct gamma distribution

claims.claim: Author says quantitative conclusion requires odd particle coupled to parameterized anharmonic or gamma-soft vibrator and actual data fit; such results unavailable. Conclusion says no quantitative conclusion can be drawn and calls for more measurements.
claims.dependency_and_boundary: proposed comparison not completed; not a modern claim of absent literature

claims.claim: About plus/minus2deg quoted in conclusion for195Au/137Nd is conditional model spectral sensitivity, not experimental CI, wavefunction sigma_gamma or PES curvature.
claims.locator: PDF23–24/printed163–164 conclusion; PDF22 gamma stability discussion
claims.dependency_and_boundary: task calibration of interpretation, no uncertainty model supplied

claims.claim: Necessary context lists missing shape fluctuations, Coriolis attenuation, pair blocking, other-j and3+qp mixing; avoids unrestricted best fits and limits unique-parity low-excitation families near2Delta.
claims.dependency_and_boundary: same PartI model lineage; no new mixed-j or high-excitation computation

claims.claim: 133Ce lowest9/2 discrepancy remains despite triaxial improvement; no ad hoc Coriolis attenuation used, selfconsistent core-inertia extension to three axes left open.
claims.dependency_and_boundary: published data cited Refs26/27; not independently remeasured; no actual WK22 input transfer

claims.claim: Abstract coexistence refers to DeltaI=2 and DeltaI=1 band structures explained by asymmetry of one model shape; Fig10/fitted gamma do not establish two simultaneous experimental shapes.

Existing particle-phonon/Alaga alternatives are discussed as nonmatched or pending comparisons; PartII does not execute a quantitative model competition against gamma-dynamic odd-A core in this section.
claims.dependency_and_boundary: cited Refs38–41 not independently read; source dated1975

claims.claim: Acknowledgments identify187Ir information supplied before publication with permission; PartII compiles existing data and shares PartI model, not an independent new campaign.

crosschecks_not_executed: Return to Refs13/42 or matched evaluated level records for190Os/124Xe endpoints, assignment, covariance/version before ratio uncertainty; exact gamma-independent limiting test only.
Read Ref33 Hamiltonian/metric and rms definition; retain196Pt vs196Hg column identity before same-nucleus comparison.
Use actual fixed-input rigid versus beta/gamma-dynamic odd-core fit with held-out EM, not invented wavefunctions or source CI.
For133Ce return Refs26/27 for energy zero and9/2/11/2 links before matching modern WK22 states.
